description: Shortest-path algorithm selector defaulting: any value other than the exact strings dijkstra or astar_zero (missing key, bogus algorithm, uppercase variant, or null type) falls back to the astar_manhattan coordinate-heuristic branch.

input.scenario: algorithm key absent -> default astar_manhattan branch
unsupported algorithm name falls back to astar_manhattan
capitalized Dijkstra is not an exact match (case-sensitive)
null algorithm coerces to empty and defaults to astar_manhattan
